node: Dry-type transformers, magnetics, and power-quality equipment
summary: Layer 1B expands the direct US-listed universe for transformer-adjacent and power-quality equipment. The best pure North American dry-type transformer reference from the provided context is Hammond Power Solutions, but it is not a primary US-listed common equity, so it is excluded from candidates and kept only as a benchmark. US-listed exposure clusters into: large-cap/reference electrical equipment leaders with data-center PDU transformer or electrical-room exposure; mid-cap/smaller power systems and magnetics suppliers; and one micro-cap speculative exception in rugged industrial/defense magnetics. Evidence quality is strongest for Hubbell and Powell as direct data-center electrical infrastructure suppliers, moderate for Bel Fuse as a power/magnetics component supplier, and weaker/speculative for Espey because its magnetics exposure is direct but data-center/electrification linkage is not yet proven.
